pass1.passed_sub: Checks 1-9, 12-14: SBOM Gen, SBOM Policy, Signing, SAST, SCA, Secrets, Container, IaC, OPA-Run, Approval, Audit, Evidence

checks.name: SBOM Generation
checks.fix: PASS: SscaOrchestration / SBOM_Generation step present in CI stage using Syft (SPDX-JSON format). Attestation enabled via cosign with Platform_Demo_Cosign_Key.

checks.name: SBOM Policy Enforcement
checks.fix: PASS: SBOM_Policy_Enforcement template step applied at Deploy_to_Dev, Deploy_to_QA, and Deploy_to_Prod stages. SBOM_Policies policy set (type: sbom, enabled: true) active at project scope.

checks.name: Artifact Signing
checks.fix: PASS: SscaArtifactSigning / Artifact_Signing step uses cosign with Platform_Demo_Cosign_Key. SLSA provenance step (provenance / SLSA_Generation) also present. Artifact verification at all deployment stages via SscaArtifactVerification.

checks.name: SAST
checks.fix: PASS: Multiple SAST scanners present: HarnessSAST (orchestration), Wiz SAST (template), SonarQube SAST (ingestion), Snyk SAST (ingestion), Semgrep (orchestration). Rich coverage across 5 SAST tools.

checks.name: SCA
checks.fix: PASS: SCA scanners present: BlackDuck (ingestion) and Snyk SCA (ingestion) in parallel SCA step group. HarnessSCA also runs on container image post-build.

checks.name: Secret Detection
checks.fix: PASS: Gitleaks step is the FIRST step in the CI stage, running in orchestration mode against the repository. Secret scan results propagated to Jira/ServiceNow update fields.

checks.name: Container Scanning
checks.fix: PASS: Pipeline contains BuildAndPushDockerRegistry step and container scanning is present via HarnessSCA (orchestration, container), Wiz Container (orchestration), AquaTrivy (orchestration), and JFrog Xray (ingestion, conditionally disabled). Multiple container scanners provide deep coverage.

checks.name: IaC Scanning
checks.fix: PASS: Pipeline contains IACM stage (Dev_Cluster_Up) with Terraform init/plan/apply. Wiz IaC template step scans IaC in /harness/iacm/terraform during the provision stage.

checks.name: OPA Policy Set (On Run)
checks.fix: PASS: Multiple pipeline-type policy sets with On Run gate active and confirmed passing in current execution (governanceMetadata status=pass, evaluation_id=61023230): Only Approved Docker Registries, Warn - Forbidden Commands in Run Steps, Security Scan Required (Wiz_Scan_Required), Approval Required for Prod Deployments.

checks.name: OPA Policy Set (On Save)
checks.fix: FAIL: No pipeline-type policy set with an On Save gate was found in the project policy set list. All confirmed active pipeline policy sets (Only_Approved_Docker_Registries, Warn_Forbidden_Commands_in_Run_Steps, Wiz_Scan_Required, Approval_Required_for_Prod_Deployments) are On Run only. Fix: In Settings → Governance → Policy Sets, edit at least one pipeline policy set to add an On Save event so that unsafe pipeline configurations are rejected at authoring time. Recommended: attach Enforce_Golden_Build_Template_for_Boutique_Frontend (currently disabled) as an On Save policy. Policy: opa_on_save_gate.rego

checks.name: Severity Thresholds
checks.fix: FAIL: STO scanner steps are present but most lack explicit fail_on_severity configuration or have it set to non-blocking values. Specific issues: Snyk SAST has fail_on_severity: none (explicitly disabled). AquaTrivy has no fail_on_severity set with type: Ignore failure strategy. BlackDuck has type: MarkAsSuccess failure strategy. Wiz Container has type: Ignore. This means Critical/High CVEs can ship without blocking. Fix: Set fail_on_severity: critical on all STO orchestration steps and remove the blanket MarkAsSuccess / Ignore failure strategies, or replace with conditional waiver logic. Policy: sto_severity_threshold.rego

checks.name: Approval Gate Before Prod
checks.fix: PASS: Dedicated Approval stage (type: Approval) with Jira Approval and ServiceNow Approval steps sits between Deploy_to_QA and Deploy_to_Prod. Both approval steps validate ITSM ticket status before allowing progression to the production deployment stage.

checks.name: Audit Trail
checks.fix: PASS: Harness platform-level audit trail is enabled at account scope (confirmed via audit_event resource type availability). Pipeline execution history, governance policy evaluations, and ITSM ticket creation/update steps provide comprehensive audit evidence per execution.

checks.name: Evidence Export
checks.fix: PASS: STO scan results are persisted to Harness STO findings store. SBOM is generated and attested by SscaOrchestration step (persisted to Harness SCS). OPA policy evaluations are recorded in governance metadata. Jira/ServiceNow tickets capture security scan summaries per execution. AGR Inline Agent (this step) exports full evidence to GitHub. Note: Evidence export relies on the pipeline's own scan/SBOM/ITSM steps, not only on this AGR step.

checks.name: Build Tool Chain Integrity
checks.fix:
FAIL (CRITICAL): Three Tier-1 build tool integrity issues detected.

1. BuildAndPushDockerRegistry / Push_Artifact: No builder image version or digest pinning specified in the step spec. The Harness CI hosted runner selects the Docker build environment version. No cosign verification of the builder image. SolarWinds-class risk — a compromised build environment injects malicious code that no downstream scanner can detect because the binary is clean by checksum but the tool that produced it was compromised.

2. AI_Verify step in Deploy_to_Prod uses image shubhendupatidar/ai-verify-plugin:4.0 — floating semver tag, no digest pin. This is a Tier-1 tool that runs in the production deployment stage.

3. HarnessSCA_1 container scan uses tag: latest for the target image reference — while this is the scan target rather than the scanner tool itself, it indicates floating reference hygiene issues.

Fix: Pin BuildAndPushDockerRegistry builder to a verified digest. Replace shubhendupatidar/ai-verify-plugin:4.0 with shubhendupatidar/ai-verify-plugin@sha256:<digest> and add cosign verification. Policy: build_tool_integrity.rego

policies.name: opa_on_save_gate.rego
policies.desc: Require at least one pipeline-type policy set with On Save event gate

policies.name: sto_severity_threshold.rego
policies.desc: All STO scanner steps must have fail_on_severity set to critical or high

policies.name: build_tool_integrity.rego
policies.desc: Tier-1 build tools must use pinned image digests; floating tags and personal Docker Hub images are forbidden in production paths

policies.name: sbom_generation.rego
policies.desc: Require SscaOrchestration SBOM step after build/push with attestation enabled
